Thanks for making content for AI Dungeon! 🐉

## How to submit

1. Read [MODDING.md](../blob/main/MODDING.md) for the pack format.
2. Put your pack in `content/your-pack-id/` (or attach the exported `.json` here).
3. Open this issue with the details below — or better, open a **Pull Request** with the files
   and we can merge it straight into the game for everyone.

## Pack details

**Pack name:**
**Author:**
**Recommended level:** (e.g. 1-5)
**What's inside:** (maps / monsters / items)
**Anything the DM should know:**

## Checklist

- [ ] The game loads without warnings (home page shows no ⚠)
- [ ] I've played through my map at least once
- [ ] Monster stats feel fair for the recommended level
- [ ] No content copied from copyrighted adventures
